subject: Fiscal Year 2026 Preliminary Budget Hearings
overview: The Committee of the Whole convened for its third preliminary fiscal year 2026 budget meeting, reviewing proposals for several departments and commissions. The committee voted to keep the budget proposals in committee.

items.title: Chevalier Theatre Budget
items.summary: The committee discussed the proposed $32,640 Chevalier Theatre budget, which plans to shift its personnel line item to the facilities department budget.

items.title: Diversity, Equity, and Inclusion Office Budget
items.summary: Director Nwajei presented the proposed $120,911 DEI budget, sharing updates on the new diversity demographics dashboard and advocating for stipends for the Commission for Persons with Disabilities.

items.title: Human Resources and Workers' Compensation Budgets
items.summary: The committee reviewed the proposed budgets of $324,093 for Human Resources and $928,000 for Workers' Compensation, focusing on union contract negotiations and an ongoing classification and compensation study.

items.title: Library Budget
items.summary: The committee discussed the proposed $2,324,029 library budget, highlighting increased program attendance, digitization projects, and the need to raise hourly part-time wages to remain competitive.

items.title: Planning, Development, and Sustainability Budget
items.summary: Director Hunt presented the proposed $917,163 department budget, detailing staff positions shifting from grant and ARPA funds to the general fund and funding for ongoing zoning updates.

items.title: Boards and Commissions Budgets
items.summary: The committee reviewed proposed budgets for the Bicycle, Zoning, Conservation, and Historic Commissions, as well as an increased $9,800 budget for the Community Development Board to fund alternate members.

items.title: License Commission Budget
items.summary: The committee reviewed the level-funded proposed budget of $5,800 for the License Commission and discussed local food service requirements for alcohol-serving establishments. The committee voted to keep the budget paper in committee.
